I weighed myself every single day… and the number changed constantly. Same body. Same food. Same workouts. Different weight. This is your reminder that the scale is not fat gain. As women, our weight fluctuates daily based on: • sleep quality • where you are in your cycle • digestion & bloating • stress & cortisol • hormones & inflammation The scale doesn’t measure progress. It doesn’t show muscle gain, water retention, gut health, or how well your hormones are functioning. If you want real progress, focus on: ✔️ how your clothes fit ✔️ progress photos & measurements ✔️ strength & performance ✔️ energy, mood, digestion ✔️ how you actually feel in your body Stop letting a number dictate your mood and self-worth. You are not “up” or “down” — you are human. 👉 Follow for more honest, female-focused health & fat loss content 💫 #scaleweight #hormonehealth #weightfluctuation #femaleheal #hypothyroid
